material_findings.title: ETHOnline project submissions close Sep. 13 at 12:00 PM EDT
material_findings.summary: ETHGlobal's primary submission rules establish the project cutoff as Sunday Sep. 13, 2026 at 12:00 PM EDT, despite the broader event calendar continuing through Sep. 16. The same rules require a repository, a 2-4 minute demo video, transparent continuity provenance, and AI-use attribution.
material_findings.recommended_action: If an already-accepted ETHOnline participant intends to submit, finish and submit before the exact ETHGlobal cutoff and select no more than three partner prizes. Do not infer participant acceptance or create a participant-specific case without evidence.
